morphology.pattern_note: meN-在r前实现为me-，r保留；-kan使“倒塌、毁坏”的状态成为“使之倒塌、毁坏”的及物动作。输入包将整词误标为词根，此处依[DBP：ranap](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=ranap)校正。

senses.zh_definition: 使建筑物等倒塌、夷为平地；使某物降至与地面齐平。
senses.en_definition: To raze or flatten something, bringing it down to ground level.
senses.ms_definition: Menjadikan ranap, meratakan sehingga sama dengan tanah, atau memusnahkan.
senses.nuances: 及物动词，主语可以是人、机械或自然力量。强调严重破坏或压平的结果，程度强于一般的merosakkan。义项依据：[DBP：meranapkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=meranapkan)。

senses.zh_definition: 彻底摧毁、毁掉；引申指使希望、梦想或生活基础等破灭。
senses.en_definition: To devastate or ruin completely; figuratively, to shatter hopes or dreams.
senses.ms_definition: Memusnahkan sesuatu; secara kiasan, menghancurkan harapan, impian atau kebahagiaan.
senses.nuances: 由实际毁坏引申至抽象对象，语气强烈；meranapkan harapan表示使希望破灭，不能用于轻微失望。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Ribut yang melanda kawasan itu malam tadi telah meranapkan beberapa buah rumah kayu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 昨夜袭击该地区的暴风雨摧毁了数间木屋。
dual_scenarios.en: The storm that struck the area last night flattened several wooden houses.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Ribut malam tadi dah meranapkan rumah Pak Din kat hujung kampung.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Ribut malam tadi telah meranapkan rumah Pak Din di hujung kampung.
dual_scenarios.zh: 昨晚那场暴风雨把村尾丁叔的房子都摧毁了。
dual_scenarios.en: Last night's storm destroyed Pak Din's house at the end of the village.

messages.ms_spoken: Ya Allah, semua selamat tak? Aku nak pergi bantu kejap lagi.

messages.en: Oh God, is everyone safe? I'll go over and help in a little while.

etymology.historical_story: Ranap describes a resulting state: something has collapsed, become nearly level with the ground, or been ruined. Malay builds meranapkan around that state to express causing the destruction. Its imagery readily supports figurative expressions about crushed hopes. This is a transparent grammatical relationship; the consulted dictionary does not establish an older borrowing history.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: ranap＝已经塌毁；meN-…-kan加上“使之如此”：meranapkan＝把它摧毁。记住“状态→造成该状态”的转换。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 灾难报道中语体正式、力度强。与受灾者交谈时，应准确描述损失，避免夸张或把真实灾情当作玩笑。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于严重毁坏及强烈的比喻表达。日常物品轻微损坏通常用merosakkan；计划没有成功也不一定达到meranapkan的程度。
